title: Authorize system user management with live menu authority, bounded field validation and guarded role assignment
description: Stage 3 access-control closure for the user records that every authenticated request, the ERP-097 salesperson data scope and every operational permission decision resolves through. src/ERP.Api/Controllers/SysUserController.cs:20 declares SysUserController with only [ApiController]/[Route(`api/sys/users`)]/[Authorize] and no identity, account-state or menu resolution on any route; GetPaged 31-59 reads all users and their role links, Create 63-81 only checks the duplicate user name at 65-66, Update 85-97 rewrites status/display fields, GetById 101-128 returns role bindings, ToggleStatus 132-142 flips enable/disable, ResetPassword 146-156 rewrites the password hash and Delete 160-170 soft-deletes; the role links are written by SysUserController.Helpers.cs:11-18 SaveRolesAsync which accepts any supplied roleId, so any authenticated account can mint a user, reset an account, disable it or attach it to an arbitrary role. Reuse the existing user-management functional menu (src/ERP.Infrastructure/Data/SeedData.Menus.cs:15) on every route, add bounded server-side validation for the persisted SysUser columns (src/ERP.Domain/Entities/SysUser.cs:10-52) and validate that supplied role ids resolve to known nondeleted roles, and keep the existing unique user-name index (src/ERP.Infrastructure/Data/ErpDbContext.Config.cs:20), the seeded admin protection (SeedData.AdminUserName checks at 136-137, 164-165) and the PBKDF2 hashing semantics unchanged. No Domain/Infrastructure/schema change, no grants, no anonymous/admin fallback. Genuine isolated (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST SQL only; safe Release build plus full ERP.UnitTests.
acceptance_criteria: For every route on /api/sys/users (paged, by-id, create, update, toggle-status, reset-password and delete) require the current enabled nondeleted identity and the existing user-management functional menu before any read or write, rejecting missing, disabled, deleted and revoked-menu identities with the existing controlled non-disclosing errors and adding no new grants or anonymous/admin fallback.

Validate on create and update that UserName, DisplayName, Email and Phone stay within their persisted length bounds with UserName required and unique among non-deleted users, that Status is a known enabled/disabled value and that every supplied role id resolves to a known nondeleted role, and accept only bounded reset-password payloads, so a rejected write persists no SysUsers or SysUserRoles change and the existing admin protection and password hashing semantics stay unchanged.

Genuine isolated SQL authenticated controller tests cover the permitted privileged and menu-granted flows, missing user menu, disabled, deleted and revoked identities and invalid name, bounds, status and role payloads, and assert that denied paged, by-id, create, update, toggle-status, reset-password and delete calls read or mutate no SysUsers or SysUserRoles row while the existing SysUserControllerTests and AuthServiceTests contracts stay green.

Keep the safe Release build and the full existing ERP.UnitTests suite green, use only genuine isolated (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST databases with Integrated Security, and add no schema, entity, menu, permission or production/secret change; build completion is not stage acceptance.
implementation_evidence: src/ERP.Api/Controllers/SysUserController.cs:17-20 declares SysUserController with only [ApiController]/[Route(api/sys/users)]/[Authorize] and no Authoriz/Menu/identity-resolution reference on any action: GetPaged 31-59, Create 63-81 (only the duplicate-name check at 65-66), Update 85-97, GetById 101-128, ToggleStatus 132-142, ResetPassword 146-156 and Delete 160-170 all query and write _db.SysUsers directly. Role binding is written unguarded by src/ERP.Api/Controllers/SysUserController.Helpers.cs:11-18 SaveRolesAsync, which removes and re-adds SysUserRoles for any supplied roleId. SysUser (src/ERP.Domain/Entities/SysUser.cs:10-52) persists UserName(50)/PasswordHash(256)/PasswordSalt(64)/DisplayName(50)/Email(100)/Phone(30)/Avatar(500)/Status/LastLoginTime/LastLoginIp(64)/MustChangePassword with only attribute annotations; the unique index is src/ERP.Infrastructure/Data/ErpDbContext.Config.cs:20 and the existing user-management menu is seeded at src/ERP.Infrastructure/Data/SeedData.Menus.cs:15. The seeded admin protection is the SeedData.AdminUserName check at SysUserController.cs:136-137 and 164-165 and existing regression contracts are src/ERP.UnitTests/SysUserControllerTests.cs and src/ERP.UnitTests/AuthServiceTests.cs. There is no SysUserAuthorizationRules in src/ERP.Application/Services and an exact search of .ai/tasks returns no task listing SysUserController for live authorization.
